content:
tara: quick sync on pin metadata — ran into a weird production case where a pinned variant changed tokenizer punctuation rules and downstream outputs drifted, but runtime stayed healthy.
li: that matches a postmortem note. tokenizer diffs are subtle and we currently don't surface them in the pin record.
mohit: proposal: annotate pins with explicit compatibility axes instead of a single pinned flag. i suggest `compat_bits` (int) for fast checks, plus `compat_labels` (string[]) for human readable axes. axes include: `kv_cache`, `tokenizer`, `runtime-kernel`, `output-semantics`.
tara: also add `fallthrough_policy` with options `fallback-to-compatible|reject|route-to-old`. default should be `fallback-to-compatible` but tenant override allowed.
li: add `migration_window_seconds` so routing can honor a grace period before strict enforcement. helps canaries and slow client rollouts.
mohit: telemetry: emit `pin_decision` tag = `served_pinned|fell_back|rejected` and header `X-Redwood-Fallback: reason=<label>;from=<variant>` so clients can detect when they saw an automatic fallback.
tara: eval gating: harness should fail rollouts where `compat_bits` indicate tokenizer or kv_cache mismatch unless `force_rollout_reason` provided. create an ops ticket with repro logs on block.
li: DB: store `compat_bits` int indexed, keep labels in a compact table. expose labels in API but rely on bits for routing checks.
mohit: implementation detail: servers should assume conservative compatibility when client doesn't declare supported bits. clients can send `X-Client-Supported-Compat: <int>` to opt-in to more permissive routing.
tara: action items: tara -> schema PR with examples; li -> DB index and API patch; mohit -> eval harness gating + telemetry.
rollout-bot: deploy 1717123500: rollout started tenant=acme model=rw-llama-v2-q4 variant=quant-v2 pin=soft
li: small UX note: add `migration_hint` string field for console with suggested eval set name.
mohit: agreed. also treat tokenizer_version mismatch as incompatible.
tara: decision summary for PR: add `compat_bits` (int), `compat_labels` (string[]), `tokenizer_version` (string), `fallthrough_policy` (string), `migration_window_seconds` (int), `force_rollout_reason` (string, optional), `migration_hint` (string). default fallthrough = `fallback-to-compatible` unless tenant override.
li: sounds good. will prototype DB layout tomorrow.
mohit: i'll wire up the gating tests.
rollout-bot: deploy 1717123610: rollout succeeded tenant=acme model=rw-llama-v2-q4
